item.title: [repo] zadescoxp/order-flow-mcp
item.description: Open-source live Model Context Protocol server that streams real-time crypto order flow data and market analytics directly to AI coding agents.

item.title: [repo] White-YC/pixelmatte
item.description: High-fidelity image matting framework utilizing a pixel-space diffusion transformer to predict alpha mattes from images and trimaps in a single network evaluation.

item.title: [model] inclusionAI/Ming-Image-0.2-Design
item.description: Text-to-image model from inclusionAI. 0 downloads and 119 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
item.description: A live cross-platform benchmark evaluates computer-using agents on long-horizon workflows across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web, showing that current agents remain far from platform-robust computer use and trail humans on iOS and macOS.

item.title: [paper] StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
item.description: StateWeaver improves long-video generation by preserving cross-shot consistency and updating visual references through active state tracking and hierarchical collaboration.

item.title: [paper] ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
item.description: A benchmark assesses how well video generators follow animated 3D blockouts while preserving structure, filling missing content, correcting proxy artifacts, and binding multimodal conditions to the correct entities and events.

item.title: [paper] Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
item.description: Linear attention offers an efficient solution for long-sequence modeling via linear complexity and fixed-size recurrent states.

item.title: [paper] Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation
item.description: A method that explicitly shapes and expands the handoff boundary of visuomotor policies improves coordination between multimodal agents and robot policies, yielding higher success and lower cost.

item.title: [repo] duzhenxun/pop-agent
item.description: Local web user interface for coding agents that displays reasoning streams and tool calls, allowing users to monitor sessions and intervene mid-turn.

item.title: [paper] So Many Ways to Multiply 3times3 Matrices: A Large Dataset of Rank-23 Schemes
item.description: A publicly available dataset of 62029 rank-23 schemes for 3times3 matrix multiplication is presented. Every scheme in it has its own rank pattern, an invariant formed by the ranks of the factor matrices of a scheme, so all schemes are pairwise inequivalent.

item.title: [paper] Pretrained Tabular Features and the Measurement of Financial Proximity
item.description: Using frozen internal representations of tabular foundation models as financial dissimilarity measures in a spatial asset-pricing model yields positive estimated gains over direct disclosure distance once broad SEC filing data are included.

item.title: [paper] What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models
item.description: A tool called Vernier measures the smallest score difference a time-series forecasting leaderboard can distinguish, showing that most boards cannot separate top entries and that ranking order can change with pool composition.

item.title: [paper] When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?
item.description: AI agents now run statements against production databases, and several of the incidents that followed deleted production data, which came back only through backups or the provider's help.

item.title: [paper] CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
item.description: CARE-3D is a reinforcement post-training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning, Group Relative Policy Optimization, counterfactual evidence attribution, and group coverage sampling to improve adaptive grounded 3D reasoning and tool use.

item.title: [paper] Who Makes the Decision? Auditing an Agentic LLM Pipeline for Illicit Cryptocurrency Transaction Monitoring
item.description: Agentic pipelines that combine graph detectors, deterministic rules, retrieval-augmented generation and an LLM judge are being proposed to monitor illicit cryptocurrency flows and to write regulation-citing justifications for analysts.

item.title: [paper] Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
item.description: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved.

item.title: [model] ccore/CCORE-Web-Coder-4B
item.description: Text generation model from ccore. 5.8k downloads and 100 likes so far.

item.title: [repo] vkpdeveloper/vmbridge
item.description: Open-source server that automatically manages and provisions cloud virtual machines to run T3 Code agents per project based on activity.

item.title: [repo] pavelveter/AGENTS.md
item.description: Practical engineering framework for AI-assisted software development that provides modular rules and workflows to make coding agents more predictable and accountable.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
item.description: Memanto, a memory agent using information-theoretic relevance scoring, completes more simulated workplace tasks at lower cost and latency than the strongest reported Mem0 configuration.

item.title: [paper] DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds
item.description: DetourBench constrains environments to compute minimum action counts and residual work, enabling separate evaluation of language-model agents' success, attainment, and detour beyond endpoint scoring.

item.title: [news] Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #97
item.description: Microsoft Research highlights recent initiatives exploring coding agents, workplace AI usage, and improved extended-range weather forecasting.

item.title: [news] Credit Saison achieves 954% ROI in a ChatGPT Enterprise pilot
item.description: Credit Saison achieved a 954 percent return on investment during its ChatGPT Enterprise pilot, leading to companywide adoption.

item.description: Trending on Hacker News from diseasescuredbyai.com. 284 points and 175 comments.

item.description: Llama-cpp-rdna-boosts is a patch set for Llama.cpp that significantly improves token generation and prefill speeds on AMD graphics cards.

item.title: [news] Quoting Jack Despain Zhou
item.description: Among the many already existing effects of AI has been a great de-individualization. I open a YouTube video, and I hear Claude. I sit in a conference presentation, and I hear Claude.

item.title: [news] How to Future-Proof Your Data Career as Coding Agents Take Over Routine Work
item.description: The skills that keep you irreplaceable when AI handles the boilerplate.

item.description: Explore top open-source alternatives to OpenAI Dots for building always-on AI agents with persistent memory, task automation, custom skills, and local deployment.

item.description: Awesome-magi-2-prompts is a curated collection of text-to-video and image-to-video prompt templates, native audio-video workflows, and structured schemas.

[repo] matheusmongarde/central
item.description: Central is a free, self-hosted platform powered by a team of AI agent bosses that manage business operations, social media, and sales.

item.title: [repo] nexu-io/opengame
item.description: OpenGame is an open-source tool that turns local coding agents into a full-stack AI game studio for building and publishing 3D and mini-games.

item.title: [repo] ankurmans/caldrin-search-oss
item.description: Caldrin Search is a self-hosted SEO and AI-visibility workspace that tracks search rankings, site audits, and AI answers on Cloudflare.

item.title: [paper] Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
item.description: A counterfactual-database reward for reinforcement learning text-to-SQL agents reduces full payment to buggy queries and reward hacks, though training with its mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy in a controlled GRPO comparison.

item.title: [paper] Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
item.description: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed.

item.title: [paper] WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
item.description: WorldBridge generates coherent and controllable 3D worlds from scattered, low-overlap images by encoding references into a global scene context and using attention and latent-reference consistency optimization.

item.title: [paper] Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
item.description: Model-driven context management through a context API improves accuracy and token efficiency over harness-triggered compaction, while reusing KV caches after edits reduces prefill compute.

item.title: [paper] DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
item.description: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale.

item.title: [tool] Imagine
item.description: Imagine is a Hugging Face Space that generates paintings from typed text using your own GPU.

item.title: [model] kandinskylab/Kandinsky-ImageSR-2.0
item.description: Image to image model from kandinskylab. 4 downloads and 118 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
item.description: GOLD-SLAM integrates panoramic Gaussian splatting with LiDAR depth priors for omnidirectional SLAM, improving pose estimation and geometric reconstruction while maintaining competitive rendering quality.

item.title: [paper] Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
item.description: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English.

item.title: [paper] When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
item.description: Reasoning-based candidate selection in small language models for entity disambiguation yields negligible in-domain gains but becomes decisive under true zero-shot domain shift, with reranker uncertainty and shift explaining when the paradigms disagree.

item.title: [paper] Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
item.description: Counterfactual world models that predict alternative outcomes from observed trajectories under the same environmental randomness enable a policy gradient estimator using counterfactual returns as baselines, improving policy learning when environmental dynamics are harder to…

item.title: [repo] tuanminh26596/Genshin-helper
item.description: Genshin-Helper is a passive computer vision tool for Windows that syncs real-time game positioning and camera angles onto the official interactive map.

item.title: [paper] Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
item.description: A systematic study of harness design for long-horizon self-evolving autoresearch agents finds that context folding and selective skill deletion improve performance, enabling MLEvolver to achieve strong results on MLE-Bench Lite and KernelBench Level 3.

item.title: [paper] Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
item.description: A benchmark and gated decision model enable large language model agents to anticipate user edit requests, improving the precision of shown recommendations.

item.title: [paper] Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
item.description: ELITE enables coding agents to self-improve by integrating complementary implementation mechanisms from independently generated improvements without using downstream task evaluations in the evolution loop, achieving strong SWE-bench performance and transfer.

item.description: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.

item.title: [news] Quoting Scott Aaronson
item.description: It’s now obvious that we’ll be getting, not one-off solutions to this or that complexity question, but a whole new continent of mathematical truth, one that we’d previously only glimpsed through fog.

item.title: [news] Bare Metal Qwen
item.description: Stand-alone bootable x86-64 operating system built in pure assembly that runs Qwen3-0.6B inference directly on hardware or KVM with zero dependencies.

item.title: [news] Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
item.description: Research artifact providing a short Lean 4 proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions, built on Mathlib and passed through machine checks.

item.title: [news] The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
item.description: The New York Times warned freelance photographers against using the latest Adobe Photoshop update because its AI features can add metadata identifying photos as AI-generated.

item.title: [paper] AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
item.description: AnyCam uses an anchor object to represent cameras for video generation, enabling scale-aware and view-complete camera control and streaming generation across diverse datasets.

item.title: [paper] Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
item.description: AgenTAP is a vision-language model-based agent that autonomously predicts point coordinates and visibility in videos to improve pixel-level localization and track physical points.

item.title: [paper] Spectrum Adaptation of AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
item.description: A low-latency transfer-learning procedure for AI-native autoencoder communications fine-tunes a small subset of layers to adapt to new channel conditions while reducing training time and energy consumption.

item.title: [paper] Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
item.description: Image-to-Video Transfer improves pretrained video editors by training them as image editors on single images, enabling new video editing tasks and state-of-the-art results on OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.

item.title: [paper] LuxAvatar: Real-Time Relightable Head Avatars via Causal Neural Shading of 3D Intrinsic Proxies
item.description: LuxAvatar is a feed-forward framework that uses an animatable 3D Gaussian proxy and a neural shader to achieve real-time head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait.

item.title: [paper] A Mesh for Every Moment
item.description: MEMO is a dynamic scene reconstruction method that uses a per-Gaussian motion model and track-based initialization to extract accurate meshes at every frame from multi-camera captures.

item.title: [paper] Tokenisation is not in APX
item.description: Research proves that polynomial-time algorithms cannot find an optimal tokenizer within any constant factor unless P equals NP, meaning tokenization is not in the APX complexity class.

item.title: [paper] Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
item.description: An empirical study tests whether generated helper images improve visual reasoning and finds that image generation actually lowers mean accuracy across multiple vision-language models.

item.title: [paper] Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
item.description: Research demonstrates that AI monitor evaluation results are highly sensitive to the chosen attack policy and optimization level, which can easily mislead evaluations of monitor strength in deployment.

item.title: [paper] DynMF2: Rigid Motion Factorization by Expectation-Maximization for Monocular 4D Reconstruction and Motion Segmentation
item.description: DynMF2 is a rigid motion factorization method that uses expectation-maximization on 3D point trajectories to perform monocular 4D reconstruction and motion segmentation without requiring masks.

item.title: [paper] A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
item.description: BioScore is an unsupervised benchmark that uses spatial transcriptomics and sparse autoencoders to quantify how well pathology image encoders capture distinct cell identities.

item.title: [paper] High-Fidelity Image Matting with Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
item.description: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for image matting by transferring generative priors learned from large-scale pretraining.

item.title: [paper] Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
item.description: DART is a trace-mining method that decomposes rejected math reasoning traces and generates distinct alternative candidates to expand problem coverage and improve large language model post-training.

item.title: [paper] Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
item.description: A Mixture-of-Loops Transformer reuses key-value memory across loops and depths, and its U-shaped variant improves pretraining efficiency and inference latency.

item.title: [paper] $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
item.description: Mu-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate voice agents on joint task completion, user privacy, and multi-user coordination in closed-loop, full-duplex shared voice interactions.

item.title: [paper] Cairn: Object-Centric 3D Trajectory Priors for Steering Frozen VLAs
item.description: Cairn is a hierarchical planning framework that uses object-centric 3D trajectory priors to steer frozen vision-language-action models around obstacles without requiring fine-tuning.

item.title: [paper] LiveVAE: Causal Window Attention Makes Efficient Streaming Video VAE
item.description: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines.

item.title: [paper] Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
item.description: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story.

item.title: [paper] Sliding-Window Detection of Hidden Regimes under Stochastic Switching
item.description: Mathematical analysis derives exact error probabilities and explicit optimal window lengths for sliding-window estimators tracking hidden regime-switching processes under stochastic noise.

item.title: [paper] ProbFaS: Probabilistic Video Frame Selection for MLLMs via Multi-Fidelity Calibration
item.description: ProbFaS is a training- and label-free probabilistic video frame selection pipeline that fuses dense image-text alignment scores with sparse model judgments to improve multimodal large language models' video understanding.

item.title: [paper] Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness using Latent Space Representations
item.description: Earth Observation embeddings from the TerraMind foundation model are used to detect, localize, and classify maritime vessels from Sentinel-1 radar imagery while bypassing the original data.

item.title: [paper] What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
item.description: PhysReader is a sim-to-real feed-forward predictor that estimates deformable object material properties like stiffness and yield stress from single videos and 2D optical-flow tracklets.

item.title: [paper] The Look-Elsewhere Effect in Searches for New Physics: from Classical Methods to Machine Learning
item.description: This review examines the statistical foundations and modern challenges of the look-elsewhere effect in particle physics searches, covering continuous scans, multiple discrete tests, and machine learning interactions.

item.title: [paper] Interpretable and Accurate Hybrid Decision Trees with Selective Case-Based Splits
item.description: A hybrid decision tree architecture integrates feature-based and selective case-based splits using informative subsets of features to improve predictive accuracy while maintaining interpretability.

item.title: [paper] FineDex: Bridging Fine-Grained Human-Object Interaction Generation to Dexterous Humanoid Manipulation
item.description: FineDex is a framework that learns coordinated human body, hand, and object motions from fine-grained instructions to improve dexterous manipulation success and enable deployment on physical humanoid robots.

item.title: [paper] Stranger Things: When Objects Appear Without Their Typical Neighbors
item.description: STRANGE-Bench is a photorealistic diagnostic benchmark measuring typicality bias in vision models when objects appear outside their usual spatial contexts.

item.title: [paper] Towards Closing the Performance Gap in Cross-Modal Place Recognition
item.description: CrossPlace is a two-stage cross-modal place recognition framework that uses a visual backbone and a token-level cross-attention reranker to match natural language descriptions to reference images.

item.title: [paper] How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
item.description: Delta Residue Attribution is a method that replays agent trajectories and replaces code units to measure and analyze unneeded edits in repository-level coding agent patches.

item.title: [paper] Shape-Aware Three-Way Merge for RDF Knowledge Graphs: The schema defines the conflict: an implementation and evaluation
item.description: Shape-aware three-way merge operator for RDF knowledge graphs uses SHACL shapes to detect semantic conflicts and validate results without losing or fabricating triples.

item.title: [paper] A Survey of Security, Privacy, and Ethics of Large Language Models in Telecom
item.description: Survey of large language models in telecommunications examines privacy, security, and ethical challenges, and outlines a telecom-specific taxonomy and open research directions.

item.title: [paper] RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
item.description: RePace is an offline reasoning framework that uses a pretrained language model to determine variable speedup profiles for human demonstrations, accelerating vision-language-action policies.

item.title: [paper] Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
item.description: Training-free focus map policy for frozen vision transformers in long-video object segmentation protects targeted objects and reduces counted encoder compute while maintaining high accuracy.

item.title: [paper] BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding
item.description: BOP-Refer benchmark pairs monocular images from 9 BOP datasets with referring expressions and ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes to evaluate monocular 3D and 2D object grounding.

item.title: [paper] DocDUR-Net: Degradation-Aware Unified Document Image Restoration
item.description: DocDUR-Net is a degradation-aware unified document image restoration network that uses a perception module and adaptive feature fusion to restore degraded document images without external task selection.

item.title: [paper] Model Weights, Airlocks and Sandboxes: A Call for Technical Validation of Re-identification Tests under the EDPB Anonymisation Guidelines
item.description: Framework for validating re-identification tests under European Data Protection Board anonymisation guidelines examines measurement practices across model weights, airlocks, and regulatory sandboxes.

item.title: [paper] From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
item.description: Decision-focused fine-tuning method for autoregressive tabular transformers maximizes expected utility under cost matrices for cost-sensitive financial events.

item.title: [paper] TIDE-Flow: Fine-Grained Temporal Evidence and Structured Displacement Matching for Spike Optical Flow
item.description: TIDE-Flow is a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that uses temporal integration evidence and displacement evidence encoding to model motion from spike camera binary streams.

item.title: [paper] DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
item.description: DRBench Pro is a knowledge-centric benchmark using local knowledge trees and evidence-grounded rubrics to evaluate the breadth and depth of coverage in professional deep research agents.

item.title: [paper] Real2SimLab: A Unified Platform for Real-to-Simulation Transfer
item.description: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry.

item.title: [paper] Put the World Back: Timestamps Matter in Time Series Reasoning
item.description: Diagnostic protocol that distinguishes timestamp-grounded reasoning from correlational shortcuts in large language models by evaluating performance under controlled temporal interventions.

item.title: [paper] Probing Visual Idiosyncrasies in Text-to-Image Models
item.description: ResNet-50 classifier that identifies the source of images generated by text-to-image models with high accuracy by detecting subtle visual idiosyncrasies.

item.title: [paper] Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent: Self-Structuring Learning through Question Answering
item.description: Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent is an algorithmic framework that iteratively optimizes knowledge base structures for large language models using question-answering discrepancies.

item.title: [paper] Provably Efficient Offline Discounted Reinforcement Learning under Recursive Entropic Risk
item.description: Model-based algorithm called ERM Value Iteration Lower Confidence Bound that establishes rigorous sample complexity guarantees for offline reinforcement learning under recursive entropic risk.

item.title: [paper] Diffusion Steering via Adaptive Reward Estimation and Resampling
item.description: TrailMix is a training-free method that adaptively guides text-to-image diffusion generation by redistributing probability toward parallel lookahead trajectories with higher reward scores.

item.title: [news] datasette-charts 0.3a0
item.description: Python package datasette-charts adds support for rendering chart annotations with lines, shaded areas, and labels.

item.title: [paper] Proverbs As A Window On Collective Prescriptions
item.description: Computational framework using large language models to analyze thousands of English proverbs, quantifying their prescriptive power and recommendations across human judgment domains.

item.title: [paper] Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
item.description: Proximal Bregman response function framework that repairs trustworthiness failures in distilled language models while preserving downstream performance and avoiding the original transfer corpus.

item.title: [paper] Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
item.description: Empirical study comparing how joint-embedding predictive architectures and recurrent state-space models shape epistemic uncertainty through their training objectives and architectures.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
item.description: SPIRE is a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework that uses high-frequency spike streams to achieve illumination-robust object detection under varying exposure conditions.

item.title: [paper] Gradient TD($λ$) for Non-Linear Function Approximation
item.description: Gradient TD method extends temporal difference learning with the projected Bellman error objective to non-linear function approximation in reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
item.description: RouteabilityBench and the Routeability Audit Protocol propose a retrospective audit package to evaluate prompt-specific variation and routeability in large language model portfolios.

item.title: [paper] The Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark: Do Language Models Know the Foundations of Early-Grade Literacy?
item.description: Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark provides a largely automated pipeline and vetted question sets to evaluate large language models on early-grade literacy foundations across multiple languages.

item.title: [paper] LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?
item.description: LoopTitan demonstrates that parameter revisit in looped Mixture-of-Experts architectures yields negligible gains when compared against matched non-revisit controls.

item.title: [paper] VulnSafe: Measuring Vulnerability-Aware Relational Safety in Large Language Models
item.description: VulnSafe is a Chinese capability assessment framework that measures vulnerability-aware relational safety and response competence across large language models.

item.title: [paper] Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi-UAV Data Harvesting Under Variable Team Sizes and Agent Loss
item.description: F-MADDPG is a flexible multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that enables decentralized data harvesting across variable sensor populations and permanent agent losses.

item.title: [paper] Transferring Architecture as an Optimization Prior
item.description: Cross-architecture initialization aligns a target network to the representational geometry of a guide network, transferring optimization priors and improving downstream performance.

item.title: [paper] Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
item.description: Coding agents outperform generative video models on visual reasoning tasks by synthesizing programs that render answer videos from initial frames and prompts.

item.title: [paper] HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
item.description: HOG-WAM improves visually robust control in world-action models by adding future Histograms of Oriented Gradients as auxiliary structural supervision through a training-only HOG diffusion transformer, yielding higher success under observation corruptions while preserving the…

item.title: [paper] WorldExpand: Building Coherent 3D Worlds via Sparse Joint Panoramic Expansion
item.description: WorldExpand builds coherent 3D worlds from a single panorama by jointly generating sparse, high-resolution panoramic observations using coverage-guided view selection and joint diffusion.

item.title: [paper] Barron Smoothness for Layers in Deep Neural Networks
item.description: Barron smoothness framework characterizes optimal discretization errors for deep neural networks using layer-wise generalizations of Barron norms and an equidistribution principle for local minima.

item.title: [paper] Guidance as Variance Matching
item.description: Variance-matched guidance is a closed-form rule for diffusion models that selects guidance scales by matching predicted variance to data variance, recovering hand-picked scales and improving sample quality without tuning.

item.title: [paper] Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Split-RL is a gradient boosting trees reinforcement learning algorithm that isolates conflicting feedback objectives by routing updates into disjoint state-space regions to prevent signal interference.

item.title: [paper] CIRKDV2: Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation with Contextual Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
item.description: Cross-Image Relational KD V2 is a semantic segmentation knowledge distillation method that transfers structured pixel and channel relations modeled from global images to improve student feature representation.

item.title: [paper] PersonaFactory: Stylistic User Prompt Augmentation with Synthetic Persona Bank
item.description: PersonaFactory is an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to produce structured synthetic user prompts and multilingual conversations for training and evaluating large language models.

item.title: [paper] SceneDesigner3D: Agentic Evolutionary Search for Principled Rearrangement of 3D Indoor Scenes
item.description: SceneDesigner3D is an agentic evolutionary search method that uses vision-language models to systematically rearrange 3D indoor scenes based on aesthetic, physical, and functional design principles.

item.title: [paper] Generation as Reverse Encoding
item.description: RevFlow is a generative framework that uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets to accelerate both learning and sampling in diffusion models.

item.title: [paper] Comparative Study of Deep Learning Architectures for Brain Tumour Classification
item.description: A comparative study of deep learning architectures for brain tumour classification evaluates six models using a leakage-aware data pipeline to ensure robust cross-dataset generalization.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive Reliability Reserves for Residential Battery Fleets
item.description: HomeFleet-ERCOT is a residential battery benchmark and controller suite that explores adaptive reliability reserves to improve backup coverage and economic margins during power outages.

item.title: [paper] When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
item.description: SPLICE is a reinforcement learning method that constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories to improve agent performance on long-horizon tasks.

item.title: [paper] DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity
item.description: DFly2 is a block-parallel speculative decoding drafter that shares the target model's KV cache and sparsity selections to eliminate the drafter's context cache and scoring pass.

item.title: [paper] Make the Adversary Spend More: Stateful Deception as a Cost-Exchange Primitive for AI-Era Cyber Defense
item.description: Stateful deception framework for cyber defense that uses adversary-specific persistent state and local language models to impose high computational costs on attackers while reducing defender resource expenditure.

item.title: [paper] When to Trust a PFN: Detecting Harmful Shift in Tabular Foundation Models
item.description: CALD is an unsupervised monitor that detects harmful out-of-distribution shifts in tabular foundation models by finetuning the decoder to maximize disagreement with test predictions.

item.title: [paper] InterConRank: Joint Node Centrality in Interconnected Heterogeneous Networks
item.description: InterConRank is a joint node centrality algorithm that computes separate, interconnected rankings for each layer of a heterogeneous network to improve node importance evaluation.

item.title: [paper] TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
item.description: TASK memory is a framework combining text notes, activation steering, and knowledge editing to eliminate memory-use hallucinations in large language model agents.

item.title: [paper] One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
item.description: SEPO is a training-free system prompt ensemble optimization framework that generates diverse, high-quality, and novel responses by evolving and selecting system prompts.

item.title: [paper] Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
item.description: Scoring system using token readouts to evaluate model diffing methods for backdoor detection, showing that the J++-lens improves weight-based backdoor identification.

item.title: [paper] Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
item.description: CARE-OPD is an adaptive on-policy distillation method for long-horizon agents that expands history coverage and uses execution evidence to reduce training time and environment actions.

item.title: [paper] What Is a Theory Worth to an LLM Solver? Measuring, Inducing, and Merging Theories in Context
item.description: Method for measuring the value of mathematical theories to large language model solvers by evaluating how stated or self-induced theories improve problem-solving success and efficiency.
